The '''invasion of Eriadu''',<ref name="THRA 10" /> also known as the '''Eriadu occuaption''',<ref name="THRA 11" /> took place when the [[Nihil]] invaded the [[planet]] [[Eriadu]] during the [[Nihil]] conflict. Though some had managed to evacuate before the [[Stormwall]] had engulfed Eriadu, other [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] and [[Jedi]] operatives remained trapped in the world's blockaded [[Bri-Phrang City|Bri Phrang City]].<ref name="THRA 10" />
